answer: The sable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mesa is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
